name: Braaied mielies
summary: Mielies (corn on the cob) cooked over the coals until sweet and charred in spots, then brushed with butter and chicken spice.
about: Mielie is the South African word for maize. Roasted cobs, umbhona in isiZulu and isiXhosa, are sold from street-side fires across the country in summer, and at home they go on the braai grid beside the meat. Butter and salt, or a shake of chicken spice, is all they need.

ingredients.name: Fresh mielies
ingredients.note: corn cobs, husks and silk removed

steps: Light the braai and let the coals burn down to medium heat: you should be able to hold your hand above the grid for 5–6 seconds. Indoors, heat a griddle pan over medium-high heat.
Brush the mielies lightly with some of the melted butter.
Cook the mielies on the grid for 15–20 minutes, turning a quarter turn every 3–4 minutes, until the kernels are bright yellow, tender when pressed and charred in patches all round.
Stir the chicken spice and paprika into the remaining butter. Brush it over the hot mielies and serve straight away, with a squeeze of lemon if you like.
